title: Justin Herbert 2023 Donruss #158 Los Angeles LA Chargers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a Justin Herbert football card from the 2023 Donruss set, featuring the Los Angeles Chargers quarterback in his iconic uniform. The card is a part of the base set and has the card number 158. It is a standard-sized trading card manufactured by Donruss in the United States.

This card is perfect for any NFL or football fan who wants to add a card of Justin Herbert to their collection. The card is not autographed or signed by the player, but it is a great addition to any sports trading card collection. Get this card today and add it to your collection!
